title: MSFS 2024 PC Marketplace Update: New A320 Southwest “What If” Missions + D‑Day Normandy!
description:
Southwest Airlines in an A320? 😱 This week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace update brings a "What If" twist you have to see! We are also flying the brand-new D-Day Normandy history mission and taking command as a Turkish Airlines Captain.

Whether you want high-stakes airline missions or scenic discovery flights in "Unique Places," the March 7th update for PC is one of the best yet.

Which one are you flying first? Let me know in the comments! 👇

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week: 
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – A320 SOUTHWEST WHAT IF (A320 airline-style missions with a fun “what if” flavor) 
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Turkish Airlines (IFR captain vibes in the A320 for a flag-carrier route feel) 
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air – D-Day – The Normandy Invasion (history-driven mission set over Normandy) 
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 8 (scenic discovery-style routes to memorable landmarks) 
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 9 (more “wow” locations for relaxed exploration flying) [flightsimulator.com]

If this helped, hit Like, Subscribe, and tell me in the comments which one you’re flying first  the A320 Southwest “What If,” the Turkish captain run, or the Normandy history mission? 😊

Thanks for watching, happy flying, and smooth landings… ✈️ See you in the skies!
